text:
emily: Heads-up: Healthly.ai opened ticket #12022 asking for streaming fncall frames to their webhook so their UI can render partial structured outputs during user flows. They need this for a pilot in ~3 weeks.

ryan: Are they asking for deltas or full JSON per frame? Any auth changes?

emily: Full JSON per frame (self-contained). No auth changes. Fields requested: call_id, seq, event (partial|final), payload, schema. Ordering is important but they can tolerate best-effort with seq numbers.

dev-bot: Note: existing text streaming uses SSE and token deltas. Emitting full per-frame JSON requires server-side assembly of function args -> extra KV writes.

tara: engineering note: options: (1) best-effort per-shard seq + client-merge (2) brokered ordered relay. Rough: (1) 2 sprints, (2) 5 sprints. For pilot, (1) seems fine if we provide idempotency keys.

ryan: MVP proposal: opt-in feature flag for Dedicated, header X-Streaming-Frame: fncall_v1, include frame_uuid and seq, retention 24h for replay, docs + example verifier. Tag as P1 customer-blocking for the pilot.

product-bot: Created backlog card HLTH-12022 and linked ticket.

emily: action items: ryan - draft API example and SDK notes; tara - prototype server assembler and measure perf; ryan - define idempotency/dedupe semantics for repro; emily - run scoping call with Healthly.ai tomorrow.

ryan: will also add a `streaming_webhook_debug` boolean for debug logs retention.

tara: agree on retention=24h for beta. We should document best-effort ordering and retries in acceptance criteria.

emily: I'll update the backlog card with acceptance criteria: schema v1 doc, feature flag, e2e replay test, idempotency model, rate limits, and rollback plan. Will post scoping notes after call. :calendar:
